ingest.note: Streaming STT accepts 16 kHz 16-bit PCM via the real-time WebSocket.

egress.note: Outputs partial and final transcripts as JSON.

potholes.note: AssemblyAI streaming requires 16 kHz 16-bit mono PCM. Telephony μ-law 8 kHz must be decoded + resampled first.
Turn events have end_of_turn field; only act on finalized turns (end_of_turn: true) for tool-calling or database writes.
Streaming is billed per session duration, not audio sent. Always send a Terminate message when done to avoid 3-hour auto-close billing.

Sessions remain open until Terminate or the 3-hour cap. KeepAlive is only needed with inactivity_timeout; wait for the Termination receipt because billing follows open-session duration, including idle time.

latency_evidence.methodology: Callsmith architecture-budget placeholder; benchmark in the deployment region before setting an SLO.

interruption.description: AssemblyAI Universal streaming emits Turn events. A turn with end_of_turn=true signals the user finished speaking, which can trigger interruption if the agent was outputting.
interruption.code_hint: Subscribe to Turn events with end_of_turn field. On turn end during agent speech, trigger interruption.

deployment.self_host_notes: Managed streaming API; no model self-host path is declared in this pack.
